messages:
claire: Heads-up: planning SDK 3.2 unpin in eu-west tonight 23:00 PT. Found a quant/kernel mismatch affecting qv2-legacy models. Propose sticky runtime pin for qv2 group until microkernel patch lands.
diego: +1. Stagger unpin: non-qv2 first, leave qv2 on pinned runtime. Slices 10/40/100.
sam: I'll add holdlist and explicit route for qv2-legacy to runtime v2.14.1+kvcache. opsctl snippet: opsctl holdlist add qv2-legacy --reason "quant-kernel-mismatch" --expires 2026-03-25T04:00:00Z
infra-bot: opsctl pin create --target runtime:2.14.1+kvcache --scope model-group:qv2-legacy --expires 2026-03-25T04:00:00Z -> OK id=pin-9907
sre-oncall: Reserving 2 canary pods eu-west-1 + 1 eu-central for warmup. Healthcheck target 200rps. I'll publish runbook and alert queries.
deploy-bot: scheduled: SDK unpin (eu-west) @2026-03-23T23:00:00Z. Canary: eu-west-1 (2 pods). Rollout: 10% -> 40% -> 100% over 30m. Escape hatch: deploy-bot rollback --id sdk-eu-unpin --reason "telemetry-trigger"
diego: Rollback triggers: 1) 5xx rate +0.5% vs baseline 2) p95 latency +30% for qv2-legacy after routing 3) token-error-rate/oom spike 4) eval drift >4% on core prompts. If any, abort & re-pin SDK.
claire: Ops checklist pre-23:00: holdlist present (sam), runtime pin active (infra-bot), canaries warming (sre-oncall), alerts configured (sre-oncall), release notes drafted (claire), on-call alerted (sre-oncall).
sam: Holdlist + runtime pin done, warming canaries now.
sre-oncall: Canary pod-1 healthy, pod-2 warming. Will post monitoring links.
deploy-bot: started: SDK unpin slice 10%. Canary pod-1 healthy; pod-2 still warming.
diego: Monitoring looks ok so far. 20m cooldown between slices.
sre-oncall: pod-2 healthy -> advancing to 40% per plan. Ready to abort on alerts.
claire: If rollback occurs, docs & support to be notified. I'll prepare a short customer note.
deploy-bot: completed: SDK unpin (eu-west) reached 100% at 2026-03-24T00:05:12Z. No rollback triggered.
